long_biography.plain_text:
Years of boating in the Red Sea gave Tarek Khalil firsthand experience of Egypt's marine-service market before he began distributing motorboats. When Sanlorenzo entered Egypt, his company paired boat sales with after-sales support from El Gouna, serving customers across the country. The arrangement extended his existing marine distribution work.

Khalil created Fairline dealerships in Egypt and Lebanon, then established a Dubai office through an affiliated company to serve Gulf clients. Alkhalil Trading now operates from El Gouna and Cairo, providing sales, handover, service and storage support. In 2024, he appeared at a Gulf marine-industry summit as the company's managing director and representative for Sanlorenzo and Princess in Egypt.
